Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief report says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, with the latest jobs figures prompting both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant describes itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss eatery serving cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your introduction and email make it clear whose site it is and how to contact you. Based on the content I could access, I’d suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your interests or projects so visitors can get to know you better.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives your blog a clear personal starting point. Based on the content I could access, I’d love to see posts about your favorite trails, with photos and practical details such as distance, difficulty, and tips—those would make it more useful and engaging for fellow hikers.
